verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a state filing office's online filing flow could publish its operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts. Nothing in the pack does so. The docs cover fees, the online-filing link, and expedite processing tiers, which describe processing turnaround rather than availability windows or session limits. The filing-app host itself could not be fetched, so nothing from it could be checked.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
